_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Momentum, ETF flows, and supply dynamics support continued upward travel toward Euphoria, but the analyst's divergences cap conviction at medium until fed_liquidity confirms the risk-on regime.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call direction UP toward Thrill/Euphoria, but the analyst assigns medium conviction with explicit invalidation conditions while the narrative writer implies higher confidence without hedging
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity ticks above 20 with stablecoin_growth recovering above 60 and funding staying below 70
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 85 with gold_strength holding 100 and btc_momentum_30d rolling below 80 — risk-off macro override
